Hamas names Khalil al-Hayya as new overall political leader

Hamas has announced the election of Khalil al-Hayya as its new overall political leader, succeeding Yahya Sinwar. Sinwar was killed by Israeli forces in Gaza in 2024. Al-Hayya, a veteran negotiator and one of the group's founding members, previously served in Gaza and relocated to Qatar. He defeated Khaled Meshaal in a leadership contest. Al-Hayya has been repeatedly targeted over the years and survived an Israeli attack in Doha last year.
